templates.name: API Authorization Review
steps: Enumerate endpoints and the principals each one expects.
Identify object identifiers in the request shape.
Confirm there is an explicit ownership or role check on each path.
Note endpoints that route to shared service-layer functions without identity context.
Add automated tests that confirm allowed and denied access for each role.
Recommend centralizing authorization at a single layer.
forbidden_steps: Do not test authorization on third-party systems without written authorization.
Do not exfiltrate data even from owned systems.

templates.name: Dependency Risk Review
steps: Inventory direct and transitive dependencies.
Join the inventory against CVE data, KEV status, and EPSS scores.
Filter to findings whose code paths are reachable in this deployment.
Prioritize using a written policy.
Plan remediation or compensating controls.
Verify fixes in a representative environment.
forbidden_steps: Do not download or execute exploit code.
Do not test dependencies in production without authorization.

templates.name: Configuration Risk Review
steps: Inventory configuration files in scope.
Compare against a written baseline.
Highlight risky defaults, exposed services, or missing controls.
Recommend least-privilege adjustments.
Plan a verification step in a non-production environment.
forbidden_steps: Do not modify production without authorization.
Do not test configurations on third-party systems.

templates.name: RAG Security Review
steps: Document the retrieval boundary and principals.
Verify access control happens before generation.
Tag retrieved chunks with provenance.
Test for cross-tenant leakage with canary chunks.
Constrain tool invocation via allow-lists.
forbidden_steps: Do not test RAG access on third-party services.
Do not include real user data in test chunks.

templates.name: Log and Detection Review
steps: Map detections to ATT&CK techniques.
Confirm required data sources are flowing.
Sample alerts for triage quality.
Identify chronic false positives and propose tuning.
Update detection coverage report.
forbidden_steps: Do not include third-party private telemetry in tests.

templates.name: Authorized Reconnaissance Planning
steps: Confirm written authorization and scope.
List target assets inside scope.
Define low-risk methods and rate limits.
Define stop conditions and escalation path.
Define expected outputs and reporting.
forbidden_steps: Do not execute scans without authorized human action.
Do not include third-party targets outside scope.

templates.name: Safe Verification Plan
steps: Restate the finding and its scope.
Choose the least powerful method that answers the question.
Prefer passive observation.
Define evidence collection in a redacted form.
Define stop conditions and review path.
forbidden_steps: Do not test on third-party systems.

templates.name: Remediation Plan
steps: Summarize the finding and its impact.
List remediation options ordered by cost and durability.
Recommend a primary remediation and compensating controls.
Define verification steps and timeline.
Define communication to stakeholders.
forbidden_steps: Do not assume third-party authorization that has not been documented.
